## Flagship Systems & Case Studies

### 1. First Step Sr. Sec. School Enterprise Platform (2025–2026)
- **Scope:** Full-scale digital redesign and institutional management platform for a 34-year educational institution.

### 2. Watermelon UI & Interactive Micro-Lab Primitives
